title: tests/migrate: update DST caveat test for R3 (+1h export)
description: vouch-ey47.19 R3 exports valid-before = end + 1h, so docs/guide-regulars.md no longer carries the TZ=UTC caveat. tests/migrate/test_guide_regulars.py::test_dst_caveat_on_the_page_holds still asserts 'TZ=UTC' in the page and that bob-6.99 fails under DST; both are now wrong and the test is red. Migrate owner: replace it with an assertion that a tag signed just before retirement verifies on OpenSSH 9.6 under DST (TZ set to a DST zone), using git verify-tag as oracle.
